care-queue-jane-doe.scriptText: Welcome to SpiritualSolace. Today we’ll follow Jane Doe, a demo resident receiving spiritual support through a coordinated care plan.

person-header.scriptText: Jane’s record keeps the person at the center, with her room, age, faith preference, and support context visible before anyone takes action.

current-need-next-safe-step.scriptText: Every care need is paired with a clear next safe step, so the team knows what to review before moving forward.

care-plan.scriptText: The spiritual care plan organizes prayer, visits, family encouragement, and church connection into one shared support record.

quick-actions.scriptText: Quick Actions let the care team send prayer requests, schedule visits, add follow-ups, contact churches, and record notes from one place.

send-prayer-request-action.scriptText: Prayer requests stay consent-confirmed and human-reviewed before they become part of the care timeline.

add-follow-up-action.scriptText: Follow-ups help make sure spiritual care needs are not forgotten after the first contact.

schedule-visit-action.scriptText: Visits can be scheduled through the same approved workflow, keeping support coordinated and visible.

contact-church-action.scriptText: Church contact uses consent-aware sharing, so outside coordination stays limited, respectful, and reviewed.

care-timeline.scriptText: Every care action becomes part of Jane’s timeline, creating continuity, accountability, and a clear story of support.

recent-activity.scriptText: Recent activity gives the team a quick view of what changed, who acted, and what still needs attention.
